children.game_version: The dance is already structured as 'folk-games' for school-age children.

social_formats.description: Groups called laers participate in communal singing and dancing at gatherings called saamtrekke.

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Dancers organize into groups known as laers and participate in large gatherings called saamtrekke.

signature_moves.description: The general term for the folk-games and dances performed by the laers.
signature_moves.name: Volkspele

music_profile.sound_description: The sound is characterized by communal folk-singing in Afrikaans, originally adapted from Swedish melodies, performed during social 'folk-games'.

teaching.level_notes: Courses are divided into Judith Pellissierweek (grades 5-7), Vormingsweek (grades 8-9), and Pellissierweek (grades 10-12).
